name: Spellbane Shield
body:
Source Melee Tactics Toolbox pg. 23
Aura strong abjuration CL 15th
Slot shield; Price 79,180 gp; Weight 45 lbs.
Description
This massive iron-covered +2 tower shield grants the wielder a +3 resistance bonus on saving throws against spells, spelllike abilities and supernatural abilities, and reduces hit point damage taken from such sources by 10 points.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, spell resistance; Price 39,680 gp
